positions.name: DayOldMarkdownTimingAndSignage
positions.frame: how should day-old bread markdown timing and shelf-price updates be coordinated to maintain sales velocity and point-of-sale transparency?
positions.why: Both statements cohere around the operational scheduling of end-of-day discounts, synchronizing the 2 p.m. price cut with immediate shelf-tag adjustments to capture afternoon foot traffic and eliminate checkout discrepancy.
